name: Korah (descendant of Levi)
title: Rebel leader against Moses
summary: Korah was a Levite who led a rebellion against the authority of Moses and Aaron in the wilderness. He challenged the Levitical priesthood and demanded that the entire people be regarded as equally holy. His rebellion ended dramatically when the earth opened up and swallowed him and his co-conspirators.

children: Elkanah (son of Korah, a Korahite Levite)

keyEvents.title: The Rebellion Against Moses and Aaron
keyEvents.description: Korah gathered 250 leaders from the congregation and challenged the authority of Moses and Aaron, claiming that the entire congregation was holy and that Moses had exalted himself.

keyEvents.title: The Incense Test
keyEvents.description: Moses challenged Korah and his followers to come forward with their incense burners the next day, so that the Lord Himself could show whom He had chosen.

keyEvents.title: The Glory of the Lord Appears
keyEvents.description: The entire congregation gathered, and the glory of the Lord appeared to them all at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

keyEvents.title: The Earth Swallows the Rebels
keyEvents.description: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed Korah, Dathan, and Abiram along with their families and everything they owned. They went down alive into Sheol.

keyEvents.title: Fire Consumes the 250
keyEvents.description: Fire came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who had offered incense.

keyEvents.title: A Warning for Future Generations
keyEvents.description: Korah's rebellion is mentioned in the New Testament as a warning example of disobedience and rebellion against God's chosen leaders.
